stem.text: The diagram shows the Boltzmann distribution of energies in a gas. The gas undergoes a reaction with an activation energy, $E_\text{a}$. The peak of the distribution is labelled P.

stem.alt: Boltzmann distribution graph: proportion of molecules with energy E against molecular energy E, peak labelled P, activation energy E_a marked on the axis with the area beyond E_a shaded.

stem.text: If the same reaction is carried out in the presence of a catalyst, which statement is correct?

A.text: The peak P is at a lower height and the position of $E_\text{a}$ moves to the left.

B.text: The peak P is at a lower height and the position of $E_\text{a}$ moves to the right.

C.text: The peak P remains at the same height and the position of $E_\text{a}$ moves to the left.

D.text: The peak P remains at the same height and the position of $E_\text{a}$ moves to the right.
